global_principles.emotion_first: The app must feel like a premium, high-end business tool, not a generic template. It should inspire confidence, efficiency, and style. Think private clinic or luxury fitness app rather than a standard salon app.
global_principles.anti_ai_patterns: DO NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans'. DO NOT use center-everything layouts. DO NOT use SaaS Blue. DO NOT use generic nested cards (cards inside cards).
global_principles.tension_and_contrast: Use bold typography, generous negative space, and sharp 1px borders instead of heavy, muddy drop shadows.
global_principles.tactile_interactions: Every tap must have a defined state (scale down slightly) and trigger haptic feedback.

headings.family: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or Clash Display
headings.usage: Headers, metrics, and primary CTA buttons

body.usage: Timeline data, client names, input fields, and lists

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Swiss High-Contrast

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use 24px (p-6) to 32px (p-8) for container margins. Dense spacing (8px to 12px) only inside functional timeline blocks.
layouts.border_radius: Subtle roundness. Use 12px (rounded-xl) for main containers and buttons, 0px for full-width lists.
layouts.shadows: Avoid muddy shadows. Use sharp, flat borders (border-width: 1px) or a very subtle diffuse shadow (shadow-sm) for floating elements.

fab_booking.style: Pill-shaped (e.g., 'New Booking' text + Icon), placed bottom-center or right. Background #2B3A41 or #D95D39, Text #FFFFFF.
fab_booking.interaction: On press: scale to 0.95, Haptic feedback (ImpactLight).

bottom_sheet.style: Used for the multi-step booking flow and filters. Top corners rounded (24px). Background #FFFFFF. Must have a drag indicator (pill) at the top.
bottom_sheet.behavior: Snap points at 50% and 90%. Smooth spring animation.

buttons.primary: Solid background, no border, bold uppercase/tracking-wide text.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid border (#E5E2DC), dark text.

empty_states.style: Center-aligned inside a full-height flex container. Large, monochromatic geometric icon. Bold H3 text. Secondary body text. Prominent primary button to take action.

toasts.style: Floating at the bottom, above safe area. Dark background (#1A1A1A), white text. Sharp corners (8px). Icon + Message.

dashboard_today.header: Large greeting ('Good Morning, Ana') + Current Date.
dashboard_today.metrics_bento: Grid layout. 1 wide block (Revenue/Earnings), 2 square blocks (Appointments, New Clients). 1px border, pure white background.
dashboard_today.timeline: Vertical list. Left side shows time, right side shows appointment card. Do not use generic cards; use a flush left border line connecting the timeline nodes.

agenda.layout: Horizontal date picker at the top (sticky). Vertical timeline grid for the day.
agenda.blocks: Appointment blocks overlay the grid. Background colors should be pale (e.g., tinted versions of secondary colors) with a solid 2px left border indicating status (confirmed, pending, blocked).
agenda.density: Maximize vertical space. Hide empty hours dynamically if possible, or keep a tight 48px height per hour.

management.layout: Flat, full-width list items. No cards. Each row has a left icon (Phosphor icon), title, optional subtitle, and right chevron.
management.hierarchy: Group items clearly (e.g., 'Team', 'Services', 'Clients') with thick typographic section headers (text-sm, uppercase, tracking-wide, text-secondary).

account.layout: Avatar/Profile section centered at the top. Followed by a settings list similar to Management. Destructive actions (Logout, Delete Account) should be pure red text (#D32F2F) with no background, placed at the very bottom.

checkout_details.layout: Drawer/Bottom sheet or modal. Clear breakdown of Service cost, Products, Discount, and Total. Massive 'Confirm Payment' button pinned to the bottom safe area.

motion_and_haptics.page_transitions: Slide horizontally (standard iOS/Android behavior), but ensure it feels snappy.
motion_and_haptics.haptics: MANDATORY. Add haptics to FAB press, bottom sheet snap, success actions (toast appearance), and time slot selection.
motion_and_haptics.loading: Use skeleton screens (pulsing #E5E2DC blocks) instead of infinite spinners for data fetching.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially inside appointment blocks and buttons, meets at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 48x48px.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: Add `testID` (React Native equivalent of data-testid) to EVERY interactive element (e.g., `testID="fab-new-appointment"`, `testID="login-submit-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are working with React Native Expo (.js files, NOT .tsx). Do not output TypeScript syntax unless specifically requested by the project setup.
Do not use generic UI libraries blindly. Build components with styled-components or React Native StyleSheet matching the exact spacing, colors, and typography defined here.
Prioritize F1 (Quick wins) - Ensure the Today Dashboard and Agenda look distinct, professional, and not like a generic template.
Never use `alignItems: 'center'` globally on screens. Let data flow left-to-right naturally.
Use @phosphor-icons/react-native or similar premium icon set (avoid thin, generic icons).
Avoid nested shadow boxes. A card inside a card is forbidden. Use layout groupings and borders instead.
Implement the UI changes specifically taking Fresha, Booksy, and Trinks as benchmarks to beat, offering a cleaner, more tactile Neo-Brutalist/Premium feel.

image_urls.description: A modern hair salon interior with stylish chairs and mirrors. Good for login/auth background overlay.
Shallow focus photo of man holding scissors. Good for team member avatar.
A confident barber in an apron. Good for active user profile.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Every interaction needs a touch state (opacity/scale) and haptics. Missing categories must not use placeholder text (lorem ipsum). Prioritize building flat, bordered bento layouts over shadow-heavy layered cards. Make sure all files use .js extension.
